title: Christmas Spirits (BBC)
identity_notes: Curated preservation compilation of 22 unique BBC radio ghost, horror and supernatural items spanning 1962-2014. It is not one historical BBC series: objects originate in multiple series, readings, stand-alone plays, serials and later omnibus presentations. The source collection page has 23 download entries because one Luke Sutherland item appears twice; the frozen GRH set keeps one unique object.

eras.label: BBC Christmas supernatural preservation compilation
eras.notes: Curator-level collection spanning many originating BBC programmes; no false single-series broadcast run is inferred.

historical_context.title: Cross-decade Christmas Spirits archive compilation
historical_context.description: The later curated archive collection gathers BBC supernatural material from many original programmes across more than five decades.

historical_context.title: Mysterious Circumstances source productions
historical_context.description: Three earliest frozen items originated in the BBC anthology Mysterious Circumstances: The Goblins Who Stole a Sexton, The Demon King and Markheim.

historical_context.title: Fear on 4 Christmas horror contributions
historical_context.description: The Snowman Killing and Gobble, Gobble originated in Fear on 4.

historical_context.title: BBC Radio 4 Christmas Spirits strand
historical_context.description: The Haunted Man, the Christopher Denys Christmas Carol rebroadcast and After Supper Ghost Stories were scheduled within the 1992 Christmas Spirits sequence.

historical_context.title: BBC Radio 5 The Woman in Black serial
historical_context.description: Susan Hill’s novel was dramatized by Jon Strickland in four parts for BBC Radio 5; the frozen collection object combines the serial.
